da94ad009bd6.line: Add more Main Street lots to the Wareham Village Reinvestment zone: vote (Article 15).
da94ad009bd6.quote: ARTICLE 15 — BYLAW AMENDMENT EXPANSION OF THE WAREHAM VILLAGE REINVESTMENT SUBDISTRICT (WV-1R) To see if the Town will vote to amend the Zoning Map of the Town of Wareham by expanding the boundaries of the existing Wareham Village: Reinvestment Subdistrict (WV-1R) to include the lots identified in Schedule A and depicted on Exhibit A, each attached hereto and incorporated by reference.

9fc253c01614.what: A citizen petition by Mitchell Cohen to change the zoning map so the Rural Residential (R-1) parts of 430 and 434 Putnam Hill Road become Village (V) zoning. A no vote leaves them R-1.
9fc253c01614.where: 430 Putnam Hill Road (M49-P226) and 434 Putnam Hill Road (M49-P224)
9fc253c01614.next: Zoning changes normally need a two-thirds vote, then Attorney General review.

3c684cf1edc1.what: Article 5 deletes words from the MBTA Communities Multi-family Overlay District rules (Chapter 275, Section 3.25, subparagraph P(3)). The Warrant Committee says the change makes clear that the larger developments must include at least 15% affordable housing, and it supports the article.
3c684cf1edc1.next: Zoning changes normally need a two-thirds vote, then Attorney General review.
3c684cf1edc1.history: Listed as Article 5 (affordability requirements) on the Select Board's Sep 15, Sep 22, Oct 6 and Oct 13 agendas during warrant review.
3c684cf1edc1.line: MBTA zone: at least 15% affordable homes in bigger projects, made clear: vote (Article 5).

50b1dd832112.what: Article 19, a petition, would add a definition of "Data Center" to the zoning bylaw (section 240-3.2) and sort data centers into tiers by electrical demand (Tier I is the small, local or edge-computing kind). The rest of the article, including what each tier would allow, is cut off in our copy.
50b1dd832112.next: Zoning changes normally need a two-thirds vote, then Attorney General review.
